entries.german:
Markgraf Christoph I. von Baden präsentiert dem Kanonikus zu St. German und Mauritius zu Speyer, Philipp von Rosenberg, als Dekan des Kollegiatsstifts zu Ettlingen, nach der freiwilligen Resignation des Erasmus Clar, den Magister Johannes Molitoris

Laufzeit: 1496 Dezember 21 (dat. die beatissimi Thome apostoli 1496)
entries.english:
Margrave Christoph I of Baden presents to the Canon of St. German and Mauritius in Speyer, Philipp von Rosenberg, as Dean of the Collegiate Foundation at Ettlingen, following the voluntary resignation of Erasmus Clar, Magister Johannes Molitoris.

Period: December 21, 1496 (dated on the feast day of Blessed Thomas the Apostle, 1496)

facts.content: served as canon of St. German and Mauritius in Speyer and dean of the collegiate foundation at Ettlingen.
